name: Holding screen — logo, message and website
description: A branded "back soon" screen for between campaigns: your logo, a short message and a line of detail, your website in large type and an optional QR code that opens it. Nothing is fetched; the code is drawn by the server.
author: ScreenTinker

params.name: logo
params.label: Logo
params.help: A PNG or SVG with a transparent background. Shown top left.

params.name: eyebrow
params.label: Small heading
params.help: A short label above the message. Capitals read best.

params.name: message
params.label: Message
params.help: A few words. Up to about 40 characters sits on two lines.
params.default: Something new is on its way

params.name: detail
params.label: Detail
params.help: One or two short sentences under the message. Enter starts a new line.
params.default: Our next showcase opens on Monday. Until then, browse the full collection and book a studio visit online.

params.name: website
params.label: Website line
params.help: Shown in large type. Write it the way people should type it, without https://.

params.name: show_qr
params.label: Show a QR code
params.help: Off hides the code, its card and its caption.

params.name: qr_url
params.label: QR code link
params.help: The full address the code opens. Shorter links make a code that scans from further away.

params.name: accent
params.label: Accent colour
params.help: Small heading, rules and the tinted panel.
